faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIPS Research Analyst position?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application email for the Research Analyst position at IIPS is 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Analyst post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD awarded or at least submitted in Population Studies, Economics, Biostatistics, or Statistics, or a Master's degree in the same fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Analyst role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Research Analyst position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this Research Analyst position?
faq.answer: The Research Analyst position is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS).

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Analyst post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the Research Analyst position.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Experience in Demography and Public health research, working with administration and project coordinators, and handling statistical software like R and Stata are preferred.

faq.question: Q10. What are the required skills for the Research Analyst position?
faq.answer: Excellent English reading and writing skills, along with manuscript report writing, editing, and proofreading abilities, are essential.
